title: Perturbational complexity should be higher during workspace dynamics

statements.text: If GNWT and IIT are compatible as IWMT says, the perturbational complexity index should be higher when workspace dynamics are present, testable by timing TMS pulses to ignition events or measuring Lempel-Ziv complexity after events such as the P300. Finding no such increase could falsify IWMT.
statements.falsification_criteria: Integrative complexity measures such as PCI are not higher during workspace dynamics, for example after ignition events such as the P300.

sources.quote: If GNWT and IIT are compatible in the ways suggested by IWMT, then PCI should be higher during periods where workspace dynamics are present.
If integrative complexity measures were not found to be higher accompanying workspace dynamics, this could potentially falsify IWMT.
